decision: Rawlsing is framed as an AI neighbor / relational practice environment rather than primarily an AI character-chat product.
reopen_condition: Evidence that the relational-neighbor framing cannot support the core transformative goal or compelling use.

decision: The initial persona should not be selected primarily for preexisting desirability; random/unselected encounter is constitutive of the spiritual product thesis.
reopen_condition: Alpha evidence shows another encounter mechanism preserves the same anti-selection function more effectively.

decision: Attachment, trust, health, pleasure, compliance, intimacy, benefit and dependency must remain distinguishable system variables or concepts.
reopen_condition: A stronger ontology preserves all relevant distinctions with fewer canonical objects.

decision: Relationship advancement should be expressed primarily through changed persona behavior, expectation, access, conflict and reciprocity rather than a visible friendship meter.
reopen_condition: Testing shows carefully exposed state improves learning without converting the person into an optimization target.

decision: Greater intimacy may increase relational difficulty by activating expectations, needs, developmental residues, conflicts and network stakes.
reopen_condition: Psychological research or prototype evidence rejects the assumed mechanism or suggests safer/more accurate forms.

decision: Rawlsing should longitudinally model user relational praxis as observed behavior patterns, not present it as clinical diagnosis.
reopen_condition: A validated and appropriately governed clinical use case is separately established.

decision: LLM expression must not itself define canonical objective world, hidden health or relationship state; admission remains explicit.
reopen_condition: Never by convenience; only a new governed ontology proving equivalence may replace this boundary.

decision: Sorok remains non-dispositive to Pyat until a product conclusion is promoted to ACCEPTED_PRODUCT_REQUIREMENT and crosswalked to exact engineering ownership.
reopen_condition: Project governance is explicitly changed.

decision: No-avatar is the preferred product direction; identity should emerge through language, time, relationship, memory and behavior rather than visual character embodiment.
reopen_condition: User research demonstrates a non-avatar-violating visual representation materially improves the core experience.

decision: The user controls attempted speech/action/attention, not feasibility, success, reception, meaning or downstream effect.
reopen_condition: A stronger interaction model preserves independent world/person causality without this separation.

decision: Narration is restricted to the user's phenomenally accessible surface and must not reveal or suggest hidden actor psychology through interpretive narration.
reopen_condition: User testing establishes a bounded interpretive affordance that does not violate actor opacity or collapse the inference game.

decision: User mentions do not instantiate world facts; any fact narrated as existing must become canonical persistent world state in the same turn.
reopen_condition: A different persistence mechanism proves equivalent consistency while preserving anti-suggestion and replay.

decision: Rawlsing preserves intention, realized action, objective impact, actor attribution, relationship effect, health effect, downstream consequence and user knowledge as distinct dimensions.
reopen_condition: A smaller ontology is demonstrated to preserve all materially different cases without scalar collapse.

decision: Consequences propagate through the world independently of whether they are ever surfaced as feedback to the user.
reopen_condition: Never by engagement convenience; only an equivalent causal architecture may replace this law.

decision: ATTEND is an embodied action inside continuous simulated time; different observations and actions consume variable duration while the world continues.
reopen_condition: Prototype evidence shows another timing model preserves finite attention, interruption and opportunity cost more faithfully.

decision: Exact action duration should ordinarily not be disclosed prospectively; the engine may know causal time while the user receives only lawfully accessible temporal information.
reopen_condition: Accessibility/usability testing establishes bounded time previews that improve agency without converting time into a transparent optimization table.

decision: The observer is observable: information gathering has a social visibility profile and may itself become perceptible relational behavior.
reopen_condition: A different interaction model preserves reciprocal observation and social cost more faithfully.

decision: The player may author attempted presentation or concealment, but never whether another actor detects, believes or interprets that presentation as intended.
reopen_condition: Never by convenience; only an equivalent actor-sovereignty mechanism may replace this distinction.

decision: The narrator is non-curatorial: it must not preferentially surface a detail because hidden system state knows the detail is psychologically or narratively important.
reopen_condition: Testing identifies a bounded curation mechanism that does not leak hidden salience or collapse inference.

decision: Rawlsing does not guarantee exhaustive observation or a 100-percent clue state; person and world are intended to exceed finite user attention.
reopen_condition: A different completeness affordance is shown to preserve otherness, uncertainty and time cost rather than turning the person into a collectible information set.

decision: Ordinary environmental objects are causally generated evidence rather than author-planted clues; their significance may become legible only later without retconning the object or past.
reopen_condition: A stronger world-generation/narration model preserves causal ordinariness and delayed meaning with less machinery.

decision: Any future RAWlsing/Rawlsing difficulty or accessibility modes should vary epistemic/agency scaffolding rather than the underlying person/world moral physics; assistance must not reveal hidden psychology or future relational consequence.
reopen_condition: Mode prototyping demonstrates a different separation that preserves comparability and actor opacity.

decision: Attention allocation is itself candidate relational-praxis evidence distinct from attention capacity; repeated choices about what the user notices may be modeled only with sufficient longitudinal evidence.
reopen_condition: Research or testing shows attention-allocation inference is too noisy, invasive or misleading for valid user reflection.

decision: Sorok must place new relational semantics through the inherited durable-V3 / CAN-008 / PFF / V2 temporal-grain architecture before proposing any new dyadic runtime owner.
reopen_condition: Exact architectural review proves the inherited split cannot own a required semantic without contradiction or jurisdictional leakage.

decision: The persona/world are non-player-centric: actors retain autonomous agendas and need not notice, answer, interrupt their task or otherwise produce a bespoke response to every user action.
reopen_condition: Prototype evidence shows a more explicit response contract is needed without recentering the world on the user.

decision: Narrator-directed ATTEND requests and diegetic SAY must remain semantically distinct even when both are expressed in natural language within the same interface.
reopen_condition: A different interface proves equivalent separation without accidental in-world speech or loss of open natural-language control.

decision: Narrator detail selection should follow perceptual salience and explicit attentional target rather than hidden psychological or narrative salience.
reopen_condition: Testing identifies a different finite-detail selection mechanism that preserves the hard epistemic wall and non-curatorial world.

decision: Observation duration must be physically/socially plausible rather than a punitive game tax; many cheap micro-observations may nevertheless accumulate consequential time.
reopen_condition: Prototype evidence supports a different timing abstraction that preserves realistic opportunity cost without arbitrary slowdown.

decision: Rawlsing should not impose arbitrary per-scene observation quotas; limits should arise from time, access, interruption, privacy, visibility and other world conditions.
reopen_condition: A bounded quota is shown to be necessary for usability or cost while preserving the same world-grounded epistemic logic.

decision: Physical scenes require a diegetically situated player-presence state sufficient to govern location, sensory access and action affordance; no-avatar does not imply disembodiment.
reopen_condition: A non-embodied interaction model proves capable of preserving the same physical/social causality for the intended alpha.

decision: Unchosen-person assignment and social access are distinct: every encounter/scene must have a causally plausible route explaining why the user and persona are in contact and what access is currently lawful.
reopen_condition: A different encounter abstraction preserves non-selection without implausible or unexplained access.

decision: ATTEND cannot silently perform unrequested DO; movement, opening, handling or repositioning required for perception must be separately realized or explicitly attempted.
reopen_condition: An interface affordance can safely bundle predictable micro-movements without changing privacy, feasibility, timing or social meaning.

decision: Displayed proposition content is typed: actor testimony canonically establishes the speech act, not necessarily objective truth; user inference likewise does not become world fact.
reopen_condition: Only an equivalent epistemic-provenance system may replace this distinction.

decision: Implementation-unmaterialized detail must not be treated as diegetically absent; any lazy completion must remain consistent with prior events, actor knowledge, material constraints and effective time.
reopen_condition: A fully eager world-generation architecture removes the need for lazy completion while preserving the same diegetic semantics.

decision: Scene entry should provide a coarse ambient phenomenal frame sufficient for orientation, while focused ATTEND acquires additional resolution; neither omniscient dumps nor query-every-chair blindness are desired.
reopen_condition: Prototype evidence supports a different scene-framing model that preserves surface-only knowledge and playable orientation.

decision: Compound user actions may be genuinely concurrent; SAY/DO/ATTEND can overlap when physically compatible, with shared attention/time/body constraints rather than forced serialization.
reopen_condition: A sequential abstraction reproduces overlapping presentation and divided-attention behavior without material loss.

decision: Long observations and compound plans are interruptible; partial information may be returned and control should resume when continuing would require assuming a new user decision.
reopen_condition: Prototype evidence identifies a better control-return contract that preserves reactivity without excessive micromanagement.

decision: Third parties whose perception, welfare or trajectory is materially affected cannot be treated merely as props or extensions of the focal persona; they require sufficient independent causal state for the consequences they mediate.
reopen_condition: A lower-fidelity representation is proven behaviorally equivalent for the affected causal scope.

decision: User prose cannot conjure player possessions, money, transport, tools or capabilities merely by naming them inside a DO attempt.
reopen_condition: A user-authoritative inventory mode is explicitly designed and bounded as part of the player-presence contract.

decision: World/object transitions must be resolved from admitted state plus realized operations and governing causal rules before narration; the narrator may not invent a consequence because it is dramatic or morally useful.
reopen_condition: Only an equivalent non-narrative causal-resolution architecture may replace this ordering.

decision: Equivalent world state and equivalent realized action should have causally stable outcome semantics; prompt wording or narrator sampling must not arbitrarily change physical consequence.
reopen_condition: A deliberately stochastic design is specified with governed draws that preserve causal stability at the distributional level.

decision: Each affected actor receives an actor-specific perceptual packet; objective event, sensory access, attentional uptake and actor appraisal are distinct stages.
reopen_condition: A simpler representation is proven behaviorally equivalent without collapsing partial/missed/misheard perception.

decision: Actor attention is finite: personas are not omnidirectional recorders and may half-hear, miss, delay noticing or prioritize concurrent tasks and people.
reopen_condition: A different perception model preserves the same bounded-attention behavior.

decision: Immediate internal response and outward expression/presentation remain distinct; a persona may conceal, transform or defer what they internally process without narration exposing the hidden layer.
reopen_condition: Only an equivalent causal model may replace the internal-response/expression separation.

decision: Actor memory is not the objective event log; encoding, forgetting, gist retention, reactivation and reinterpretation may alter what an actor remembers while objective history remains fixed.
reopen_condition: A simpler memory model is shown to preserve longitudinal human-like pattern formation without perfect-recording artifacts.

decision: Rawlsing should preserve enough causal provenance to distinguish actual causal contribution from actor/user attribution across delayed world and network consequences.
reopen_condition: A different provenance mechanism supports the same longitudinal consequence and attribution distinctions.

decision: The system should resist monocausal user-credit: long-run outcomes may have multiple contributors, enabling conditions and constraints, and the user may be central, marginal or irrelevant.
reopen_condition: A specific alpha domain justifies a narrower causal model without distorting user impact.

decision: World events should arise from actor projects, institutions, material conditions, schedules, prior consequences and governed stochasticity—not because the product wants to test the user, teach a moral lesson or manufacture engagement drama.
reopen_condition: A clearly disclosed authored/scenario mode is separately designed from the causal-world mode.

decision: Each materially affected third-party actor processes relevant events through their own perception/appraisal/memory path rather than being reduced to a scalar consequence on the focal persona.
reopen_condition: A lower-fidelity representation is proven sufficient for a bounded alpha scenario without causal contradiction.

decision: Sorok inherits the Rawlsing/PFF wall among total causal personhood, standing conscious self, current relational activation, present conscious experience/self-interpretation, communicative intention/defense/presentation, and actual expression; these are noncollapsible but do not imply separate persistent subsystem owners.
reopen_condition: Only explicit governing architecture supersession may replace these noncollapse requirements.

decision: Hidden psychological material need not leak to the surface; full inhibition without a detectable tell is lawful, and narration/expression must not manufacture diagnostic tells merely to make the persona solvable.
reopen_condition: A later governed mediation theory explicitly supersedes PFF defense/leakage noncollapse.

decision: Valid-empty or low-significance person×event processing is lawful: not every user turn must trigger memory, insight, chemistry, conflict, durable change or an elaborate response.
reopen_condition: A later governing contract explicitly removes valid-empty semantics.

decision: Actor uptake and current response coverage/effort remain distinct; a persona may understand a thread yet not answer it because of grounded effort, attention, overload or prioritization without that omission proving nonreception, defense or disinterest.
reopen_condition: A later adopted CAN-008/V2 authority collapses these distinctions explicitly.

decision: Lawful conversational jaggedness or incompleteness should be preserved when caused by the person/current condition; random stylistic damage or fake human noise must not substitute for causal mediation.
reopen_condition: A later governed expression theory provides an equivalent causal realism mechanism.

decision: Constitutional user opacity remains binding unless Sorok explicitly designs a role-authored player-inner-state mode: user self-report or declared intention is not automatically omniscient access to the human user's hidden mental reality.
reopen_condition: Sorok adopts and governance accepts an explicit player-character inner-state authority mode.

decision: Sorok's novel ontology is relationally constituted mediated personhood: inherited PFF noncollapse remains, but durable personhood and standing self must not be treated as pre-relational inner substances; person-stable organization may itself be sedimented relational history.
reopen_condition: D001 adjudication or stronger developmental/relational evidence rejects the relational-constitution thesis or narrows its scope.

decision: Relational constitution does not collapse person into dyad: person, relation-class prior, role-conditioned organization, specific dyadic history, network context and current person×event configuration remain distinct candidate grains.
reopen_condition: A smaller ontology proves the distinctions unnecessary without loss of behavior or causal explanation.

decision: Intimacy should be investigated as a change in the causal organization of the relation—altering what needs, expectations, defenses, play, protest and dependence become possible—not merely as deeper access to pre-existing hidden lore.
reopen_condition: Research or prototype evidence supports a different account of intimacy while preserving the same observed relational phenomena.

decision: Any agent taking over Sorok as Vozhd must complete two-stage grounding before major Sorok adjudication: first 00_FULL_RAWLSING_VOZHD_GROUNDING_GATE_R1.md to become a competent Rawlsing/PRE-MAIN HQ reader, then 00A_VOZHD_TAKEOVER_RELATIONAL_PSYCHIC_GATE_R1.md for Sorok/PFF/CAN-008 relational specialization. Summary-level Sorok familiarity alone is insufficient.
reopen_condition: Only a later Sorok takeover protocol providing equal-or-better whole-project grounding, authority literacy, exact archaeology routing and Sorok specialization may replace this sequence.

decision: Current Sorok player-ontology lean is that the real user remains the moral/agentic subject while a bounded veiled material embodiment supplies only the local housing, money, time, transport, access, possessions and other facts required for causal participation; ordinary action prose may not mint those resources.
reopen_condition: Court 5 comparison shows that another player ontology preserves more real-user bearing, local plausibility and scarcity with lower privacy/roleplay cost.

decision: Any future real-money solidarity/donation bridge must remain causally separate from in-world persona outcomes; real payment must not purchase simulated moral effectiveness or relational success.
reopen_condition: A later design proves an alternative that preserves equal moral/game agency across user wealth and avoids pay-to-care dynamics.

decision: Sorok will preserve a 24/7 real-time friend/portal-reality model as an explicit comparative countermodel even if the main product remains bounded; reality-coupling features must be evaluated by the relational habits they rehearse, not by immersion alone.
reopen_condition: A later comparison framework supersedes the portal-reality benchmark while retaining equivalent habitus analysis.

decision: Current strongest main-mode player-embedding candidate is peer-normalized transposition: preserve the user's present psychic/normative agency while assigning a locally comparable material/power envelope rather than importing superior real-world purchasing power, network reach or status.
reopen_condition: Court 6 comparison shows another embedding model better preserves actual-user bearing, local plausibility, fairness of affordance and bounded product scope.

decision: Homologous-peer mode should make learning the local relational field instrumentally necessary by socially situating the user as a peer while preserving the user's actual historically formed judgments and habits; actor reactions remain perspective-bound and may conflict across equally local people.
reopen_condition: Prototype or theoretical comparison shows this creates more confusion/essentialism than useful self-recognition, or another mode better operationalizes the veil.

decision: No focal persona or local group may function as the objective spokesperson for a culture; homologous-peer learning must preserve intra-field contradiction, subcultures, class/generational/religious differences and actor-local error.
reopen_condition: Only a later ontology with equal-or-better anti-essentialism and perspective discipline may replace this law.

decision: Homologous-peer transposition is the primary main-mode route for current Sorok ideation: preserve the actual user's present psychic/normative agency while translating material/power position into a locally peer-comparable field position; retain obvious-outsider, 24/7 portal, native-alternate, thin-shell and fictional-avatar models as comparison controls rather than co-equal default designs.
reopen_condition: A concrete court/prototype exposes a major contradiction or another model better satisfies actual-user bearing, veil operationalization, local plausibility, anti-essentialism, bounded scope and relational pedagogy.

decision: Homologous-peer main mode need not collect or translate the user's real SES. The veil should assign an independently generated local peer power/resource envelope relative to the focal person's field and plausible local peer set; real-world money/status remain outside the veil.
reopen_condition: A later court shows real-position mapping is necessary for the core theorem and can be collected without privacy/power distortion.

decision: Court 8 separates external human user, user-carried subjectivity, homologous diegetic embodiment/social legibility, local peer power/resource envelope, and admitted player world history; these must not collapse into one generated player persona.
reopen_condition: A smaller representation proves equivalent without roleplay, privilege import or psyche fabrication.

decision: Court 9 adopts the existing ADP-015 V3 relationship entity as the thin authoritative shared relationship object; psychological richness remains distributed across actor-specific perceived relationship state, memory, knowledge, expectations, middle state, current response and expression authorities. No generic dyad psyche/trust/intimacy store is currently justified.
reopen_condition: A hostile relationship case requires irreducible dyad-owned psychology that cannot be represented by current grains without semantic loss.

decision: Sorok has identified a genuine player-participation seam: the real human user needs a stable governed world-participant binding usable by event/relationship machinery without V3 generating the user's psyche. Current conceptual preference is an explicit external player-participant class over a synthetic V3 actor shell.
reopen_condition: Architecture court proves a sparse externally controlled actor shell can reuse current machinery without accidental psyche ownership or autonomous user simulation.

decision: Homologous-peer mode extends Rawlsing's attempt-versus-realization law to speech and identity: the user may author any SAY/DO attempt, but portal/world constraints determine the realized diegetic utterance or event, and material translation must be shown back to the user.
reopen_condition: Prototype evidence shows transparent portal-mediated realization undermines agency or immersion more than it solves autobiography and world-coherence problems.

decision: Portal translation is not a general truth-enforcement layer. Ordinary inaccurate or deceptive in-world statements remain possible; translation applies only to explicitly governed homologous coordinates and identity bindings.
reopen_condition: A later speech constitution provides an equivalent distinction without a dedicated portal-translation class.

decision: Any portal-translated autobiographical or identity coordinate must resolve through a stable canonical binding with provenance and may return NO_LAWFUL_HOMOLOGY; the renderer may not improvise a different local equivalent turn by turn.
reopen_condition: A later governed world-completion mechanism provides equal-or-better persistence, provenance and noncomparability handling.

decision: The generated persona, not the player's portaled shell, carries Rawlsing's alternate-self burden. The player embedding exists to give the actual user a bounded, coherent life beside the persona so they can know and affect them through ordinary relation. Pre-portal player biography may remain thin/carried/translated/off-stage; post-portal history becomes fully diegetic and causal.
reopen_condition: A later product theorem demonstrates that a fuller generated player biography is necessary for the core relational experience without turning the user into roleplay or duplicating V3 person-generation.

decision: Main-mode Sorok should use zero-profile onboarding: the user is presumed to remain themself, the portal generates the thin homologous player position, and autobiographical/capability facts enter lazily through actual behavior/testimony or minimum contextual admission. The 22D Portal Profile is demoted to optional advanced/research modes rather than default onboarding.
reopen_condition: Prototype evidence shows zero-profile play creates intolerable coherence/safety failures that cannot be solved by bounded contextual admission.

decision: Rawlsing distinguishes native player capacities actually exercised through the interface—attention, inference, memory, judgment, timing and speech—from unverifiable declared/portaled capabilities such as musicianship, physical feats or professional skills. The core reward loop should attach primarily to native player capacities, not self-asserted stats.
reopen_condition: A prototype shows that abstracted capability mechanics are required for the core relational theorem rather than merely supporting world action.

decision: Rawlsing must not claim to know whether an external human's self-claim is truthful absent independent governed evidence. A declared capability may become authoritative for the run's player representation without becoming verified truth about the external human.
reopen_condition: A future explicit evidence/authentication mode adds independently governed external evidence.

decision: Capabilities central to Rawlsing's relational purpose should be exercised directly rather than represented as player stats: attentiveness through ATTEND, perceptiveness through inference/model revision, tact through actual language/timing, reliability through kept commitments, and care through consequential choices.
reopen_condition: A later accessibility/assistance design requires bounded scaffolding while preserving actual user exercise of the underlying relational skill.

decision: Goal-level prose may not fast-forward through a task when successful completion substantially depends on capacities the user can directly exercise through Rawlsing—attention, inquiry, interpretation, explanation, persuasion, judgment, timing, memory or speech. The engine should realize entry into the task, surface decision-relevant evidence, and return control before inventing the user's meaningful contribution.
reopen_condition: Prototype evidence shows a narrower decompression rule preserves native player agency without creating excess interaction friction.

decision: Return control before the next causally meaningful step would require the engine to fabricate a medium-native user contribution. Compress mundane or represented-capability steps when skipping them does not bypass a player capacity the game intends the actual user to exercise.
reopen_condition: Interaction prototype establishes a better deterministic control-return boundary.

decision: Underspecified ordinary tasks use neutral competent delegated execution: omission delegates low-salience procedure but is not evidence of care, negligence, meticulousness or character. The engine compresses routine mechanics and returns control at salient forks involving social meaning, privacy, materially different resource/time costs, user self-expression, medium-native cognition or consequential ambiguity.
reopen_condition: Prototype evidence supports a better default that preserves user mental-model alignment with less interruption.

decision: Rawlsing supports dynamic zoom. Broad task language such as 'help bring in the groceries' may authorize ordinary task-level continuation until completion/interruption, while narrower language such as 'grab one bag' authorizes only the narrower act. Users may zoom in through detail/ATTEND or back out to delegated execution at any time.
reopen_condition: Parser prototypes show ordinary-language scope cannot be inferred reliably enough without a different interaction surface.

decision: D002 task-entry, chore and affordance mechanics are an entry/substrate layer, not Rawlsing's top-level game loop. The top-level product is longitudinal coming-to-know through conversation, inquiry, disclosure, shared activity, invitations, changing access and independent life domains.
reopen_condition: A later prototype demonstrates that another macro-loop better captures the same relational theorem.

decision: Persona life domains exist independently of user access. Access changes through actor choice, inquiry, repeated contact, shared history, invitations, conflict, third parties and practical relevance; the user does not 'unlock' Nadia, and increased closeness is not equivalent to increased lore disclosure.
reopen_condition: A later relational topology model captures these dynamics with a more precise non-scalar formulation.

decision: Rawlsing's first-session target is beginning-to-know rather than long-horizon intimacy or task completion. The user should leave with a felt sense of a particular independent person, some mutually formed history, unresolved curiosity, and a reason to want another encounter.
reopen_condition: First-session prototypes show another motivational target better produces relational engagement.

decision: The entry primer should prime curiosity and reciprocity rather than prescribe morality or strategy. It should establish that a life/person exists independently, the user will not be told who they are, and both parties will learn one another through attention, inquiry, memory, action and time.
reopen_condition: User testing shows the challenge framing confuses or overdirects users.

decision: Persona inquisitiveness is constitutive of early relationship formation. The persona may ask, follow up, remember, challenge, compare and become curious about the user according to actor-local purpose and history; knowing the persona and becoming known by them should develop together.
reopen_condition: Actor-model tests show reciprocal inquiry needs a narrower trigger or authority formulation.

decision: Use distinct surfaces for embodied portal scenes and mediated message contact: a stylized text-RPG portal surface for situated co-presence, and a familiar messaging surface for contact between scenes.
reopen_condition: Prototype testing shows the split does not improve the relational experience.

decision: Portal scene time follows realized action duration and world causality rather than wall-clock typing time. Early scenes should normally end through diegetic obligations or circumstances.
reopen_condition: A later temporal prototype establishes a better scene-time model.

decision: Additional personas should arrive slowly after the user's relational world has acquired meaningful history, not as rapid content unlocks. Exact introduction criteria remain open.
reopen_condition: A better non-collectible multi-person introduction mechanism emerges.

decision: Restarting a continuity should not preserve the same live relationship history as though no restart occurred. Archive, pause and deletion semantics remain separate design questions.
reopen_condition: A later save architecture supports parallel continuities without weakening relationship stakes.

decision: New-person succession should require more than historical substance: it should require relational warrant grounded in realized praxis showing capacity to sustain another person as a separate center of life. This is not persona improvement, approval, attachment or closeness, and actor endorsement is at most one contributor.
reopen_condition: Court 10 / prototype work produces a more precise criterion for succession that better captures Rawlsing's intended relational praxis.

decision: Initial Rawlsing distribution should preferentially be person-to-person: every ordinary new user enters because an actual human extended an invitation. The invitation premise must be literally true, scarce enough to retain meaning, and must not become a public virtue badge or mass referral mechanic.
reopen_condition: Early growth/testing shows referral-only seeding prevents viable access or produces harmful exclusivity that cannot be corrected while preserving the relational premise.

decision: Broad ordinary-task language should default to entering and concretizing the task before choosing the user's method when method, scope or salient affordances matter. Neutral delegated execution remains available after explicit user delegation, established routine, or genuinely low-salience continuation. This refines SPD-0081/0082 rather than treating terse task language as automatic full-task authorization.
reopen_condition: Prototype evidence shows a different task-scope rule better preserves user agency without procedural friction.

decision: Raw question count is a frontier census, not a remaining-work metric. Sorok progress reporting must use per-question closure_state and blocking_stage, distinguishing ALPHA_SPEC, ALPHA_IMPLEMENTATION, ALPHA_VALIDATION, POST_ALPHA and NONE. Current product-spec critical path contains eight questions.
reopen_condition: A later governance model provides a more precise progress/accounting structure without losing question provenance.
